# Set-ZbxValueMap

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a value map.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxValueMap [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixValueMap>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-Mapping <ZabbixValueMapMappingRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A value map turns raw item values into words, such as 1 into Up and 0 into Down, for the frontend and notifications. The Set-ZbxValueMap cmdlet changes the value maps given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with valuemap.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every value map the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed value maps back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a value map

```powershell
Get-ZbxValueMap -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Service state' | Set-ZbxValueMap -Name 'Service state (up/down)'
```

Renames the value map Service state of web-01 to Service state (up/down).

### Example 2: Change a value map and write the result

```powershell
Get-ZbxValueMap -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Service state' | Set-ZbxValueMap -Name 'Service state (up/down)' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the value map Service state of web-01 back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixValueMap>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixValueMapMappingRequest[]`: Bound to -Mapping (ByPropertyName). mappings of a ZabbixValueMapCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixValueMap`: Value map class.
